title: BRIDGE-EEG: Bridging Self-Supervised Pretraining and Efficient Deployment for Cross-Dataset EEG Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.12218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing use of electroencephalography (EEG) motivates automated analysis that is accurate, transferable, and deployable on constrained hardware. Recent EEG foundation models learn general representations from large-scale pretraining, but their size and computational cost limit edge and wearable deployment. We introduce BRIDGE-EEG, an efficient multi-task EEG classification pipeline that preserves the benefits of pretraining while reducing model size. A unified preprocessing scheme maps heterogeneous recordings with different channel counts, montages, and sampling rates to a device-agnostic 62-channel time--frequency representation. We pretrain an SE-ResNet18 teacher (11.84 M parameters) with SimCLR on unlabeled EEG from five heterogeneous datasets, then compress it into SE-ResNet8 (1.56 M) and SE-ResNet4 (0.48 M) students using task-agnostic and task-specific distillation. translated_title: BRIDGE-EEG：连接自监督预训练与高效部署的跨数据集脑电图分类
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）应用的日益增长推动了对准确、可迁移且能在受限硬件上部署的自动化分析的需求。近期的EEG基础模型通过大规模预训练学习通用表征，但其模型规模和计算成本限制了在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的部署。我们提出了BRIDGE-EEG，一种高效的多任务EEG分类流水线，它在减小模型规模的同时保留了预训练的优势。统一的预处理方案将具有不同通道数、导联配置和采样率的异构记录映射为与设备无关的62通道时频表示。我们使用SimCLR在来自五个异构数据集的无标签EEG数据上预训练一个SE-ResNet18教师模型（1184万参数），然后通过任务无关和任务特定的知识蒸馏将其压缩为SE-ResNet8（156万参数）和SE-ResNet4（48万参数）的学生模型。我们在涵盖异常检测等的六个基准上进行评估。
tldr: BRIDGE-EEG通过SimCLR自监督预训练大型教师模型，再利用知识蒸馏将其压缩为轻量级学生模型，在保留预训练优势的同时实现了跨数据集EEG分类的高效边缘部署。
en_tdlr: BRIDGE-EEG distills a SimCLR self-supervised pretrained SE-ResNet18 teacher into compact student models via knowledge distillation, preserving pretrained representation benefits while enabling efficient edge deployment for cross-dataset EEG classification.
